title: Higher-Order Sensitivity Analysis of Wasserstein and Adapted Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization Problems
summary: We investigate the higher-order expansions of the sensitivities of functionals of probability measures. Building on the work of \citeauthor{bartl2021sensitivity} \cite{bartl2021sensitivity} and \citeauthor{bartlsensitivityadapted} \cite{bartlsensitivityadapted}, who established the first-order expansion when the functional arises from a stochastic optimisation problem, we extend these results using recent developments in differential calculus on Wasserstein spaces.
